item.title: 【UPSCALED】Charli XCX - After The Afterparty (feat. Lil Yatchy)|4K 60fps AI Upscale|H.264|5.1 Dolby Digital
item.description:
On the track's official release day, 28 October, it was annouced the the track was having an official music video, and XCX's, at the time, third album was scheduled for a May 2017 release. As planned, the music video for "After the Afterparty" was released on 30 October 2016. The video was directed by Diane Martel, and features XCX and Lil Yachty partying with people dressed as zombies and other creatures for Halloween. XCX and Yachty met each other in person for the first time during the recording sessions for the clip.
